name: citeladder
description: Evidence-grounded growth intelligence platform. Root manifest: a single entry point for the install, build, test, and lint commands of the Astro/Vite frontend and native API (frontend/). It declares no dependencies of its own and is never installed — pnpm's workspace root is frontend/.

scripts.setup: pnpm --dir frontend install --frozen-lockfile && node frontend/node_modules/vite-plus/bin/vp config --hooks --no-agent
